name: venturehub
description: VentureHUB — Startup Marketplace for Founders & Investors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run server --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
